subject: Request: consolidate accelerator promo credits into reserved trial — Bright Labs
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <alex@brightlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: consolidate accelerator promo credits into reserved trial — Bright Labs

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Quick ask from our side — we were accepted into a second accelerator cohort and the program team granted us a small pool of Redwood promo credits (one-off sandbox credits). Because our usage is spiky and we expect to ramp into a committed reserved pool next quarter, would Redwood consider consolidating those promo credits into a short-term Reserved Trial (reserved capacity with 30-day conversion window)?

High level:
- Company: Bright Labs (seed-stage, SF)
- Current promo credits: $8k of sandbox credits (voucher-like)
- Goal: convert to a Reserved Trial that can be used against a dedicated capacity pilot next quarter; we expect steady usage for 4–6 weeks during integration.

The accelerator team pushed us to ask for this as an exception. If you need any paperwork from the accelerator (letter of participation) or an internal statement of work, I can attach that. Ideally we’d close this before the end of the month so procurement can align the PO.

Appreciate the help — Alex
Alex Nguyen
Head of Platform, Bright Labs
alex@brightlabs.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@brightlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: consolidate accelerator promo credits into reserved trial — Bright Labs

Alex — thanks for flagging this. Quick read: happy to explore a path here but we have a few guardrails to follow for promo->reserved conversions.

Can you confirm: 1) the accelerator grant is non-refundable (voucher/credit) and 2) Bright Labs is the legal entity that will sign a short SOW/PO if we convert? If you can send the accelerator participation note that helps.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- I’ll loop in Marissa (commercial lead) and Lauren (finance) to confirm discount/credit accounting.
- If internal approvals look ok we’ll draft a short SOW that converts the $8k credit balance to a 30-day Reserved Trial allocation with explicit conversion rules.
- Schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to confirm timelines.

Would 11am PT tomorrow work for you?

Ben
Director, Startup Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alex Nguyen <alex@brightlabs.com>
Cc: Lauren Bennett <lauren_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: consolidate accelerator promo credits into reserved trial — Bright Labs

Thanks Alex — looping in finance (Lauren) and operations (Tessa) so we can work through accounting and SOW language. Summary of a suggested commercial for this conversion (draft, subject to approvals):

- Convert $8,000 promo credits into a 30-day Reserved Trial pool assigned to Bright Labs.
- Reserved Trial provides dedicated capacity with a soft conversion option: any consumption beyond the $8k during the 30-day window converts to monthly committed Reserved capacity at a 10% introductory commit credit (applied once).
- Credits that are not consumed after 30 days expire (no cash refund) — unless the accelerator provides explicit escrow language.
- Discounting/waiver thresholds: finance needs to confirm whether we treat the $8k as a simple credit transfer or as a promo waiver for accounting. See attached credit_calculation_sheet.xlsx for the preliminary math.

Attach: credit_calculation_sheet.xlsx (calcs show conversion scenarios at 25%/50%/100% usage).

Ben — if you want to run the call, I’ll take notes and push the SOW draft once Lauren signs off.

Marissa
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bennett <lauren_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: consolidate accelerator promo credits into reserved trial — Bright Labs

Marissa / Ben — reviewed the attached calc. We can approve an exception with the following conditions (finance/legal require these to close):

1) Discount cap: the consolidated conversion cannot create an effective discount > 40% vs. standard reserved pricing. If the math implies a larger discount we’ll need CCO approval.
2) Accounting treatment: we’ll treat the $8k as a promo credit transfer on our books. No cash refund will be issued; unused credits expire after 30 days. This must be explicit in the SOW.
3) Billing/PO: Bright Labs must provide a PO referencing the SOW and the accelerator participation letter (or contracts@brightlabs.com can confirm).
4) Legal: we need a brief amendment to our MSA (one paragraph) that allows promo-to-reserved conversion for this name and deal. I’ve attached a draft SOW template (BrightLabs_SOW_v1.pdf) for review — legal will redline.

If those terms are acceptable we can sign SOW, convert the credits, and route the reserved trial to operations for provisioning. Tessa — ops, please confirm you can backfill a 30-day reserved segment on account once we push the SOW.

Lauren
Sr. Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@brightlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bennett <lauren_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Bcc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: consolidate accelerator promo credits into reserved trial — Bright Labs

Alex — good news: finance has approved the exception under the conditions Lauren outlined. Next steps and timeline:

- Please have contracts@brightlabs.com send the accelerator participation note and a PO referencing the SOW by EOD Monday.
- I’ve attached the draft SOW (BrightLabs_SOW_v1.pdf) — we’ll update the one-paragraph amendment to the MSA and route for signatures (I’ll send a DocuSign link once legal finishes redlines).
- Ops (Tessa) will provision the 30-day Reserved Trial within 48 hours of a countersigned SOW and PO.
- Conversion mechanics: any consumption beyond the $8k during the 30 days will be rolled into a monthly reserved commitment at a 10% introductory commit credit, unless otherwise negotiated.

Action items for Bright Labs: PO + accelerator participation note to contracts@brightlabs.com; confirm a billing contact.

We’ll keep this ticket open until the SOW is countersigned and provisioning completes. Congrats on the cohort — excited to support Bright Labs during the integration.

Ben
Director, Startup Programs | Redwood Inference
